v3_0_gap_fill_pass_2026_08_11.instruction: Explicit gap-filling task targeting the 3 open gaps from v2.1's known_gaps_still_open.

chakra_to_raga_mapping.summary: 0 relationships found linking a specific chakra directly to a specific raga with real clinical/peer-reviewed support -- none exist in the literature searched. 3 relationships found linking a specific RAGA to a therapeutic OUTCOME with genuine peer-reviewed support (verified via PMC/DOAJ/ResearchGate, not just a search snippet): Darbari Kanada (depression/anxiety/stress/insomnia, elderly, N=39, no control group), Bilahari (anxiety/sleep/somatic symptoms, cancer caregivers, N=30, Heliyon/PMC9508548), Bhairavi (stress markers via HRV, N=44, randomized VR design, Scientific Reports). None of the source studies claim a chakra link -- none was added. One additional source (a school-student paper in a low-tier journal, IJARIIT V10I4-1179, claiming specific raga->chakra activation effects) was investigated and its central citation could not be verified to exist -- excluded entirely, logged in chakra_raga_bridge.json's excluded_low_credibility_sources.

indian_mental_health_crisis_resources.summary: Added Tele MANAS (14416 / 1-800-891-4416, MoHFW/NIMHANS), KIRAN (1800-599-0019, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment), national emergency 112 (MHA/ERSS), and ambulance 108/102 (NHM) -- each with official source URL and verification date. US resources from v1 kept, not removed. One number (KIRAN) had a conflicting figure in a secondary source during research and is flagged for a second independent check before production.

throat_third_eye_crown_questions.summary: 6 Throat questions, 6 Third-Eye questions, 5 Crown questions (incl. explicit spiritual-content opt-in gate). All investigate underlying experience without naming the chakra or asserting imbalance. Authored fresh (no source material existed for these 3 chakras in either upload) -- flagged therapist_review_required, not clinically piloted.

gap_closure_pass_2026_08_11_v4._note: This pass addressed the 11 numbered gaps from the follow-up 'Remaining Gap Closure & Final Hardening' instruction. IMPORTANT CAPABILITY DISCLOSURE: this pass has NO live web/browsing tool available. Every item below reflects what could honestly be done with (a) restructuring/joining data already in the KB, (b) new schema/framework design, and (c) careful re-examination of source PDFs already uploaded (e.g. re-rendering the Raga Samay Chakra image at higher resolution). Nothing below reflects new external research, live fact-checking, or new source discovery -- where the original gap required that, it is marked SOURCE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED or NOT_FOUND, not fabricated closed.

A human must call the number or check the live URL before production.

Confidence and transcription method documented in-file. Kept separate from, not merged into, the existing 8-segment ashta_prahara raga_time_of_day.json.

gaps.title: 93-raga aroha/avaroha/pakad/mood metadata
gaps.detail: Honest non-closure. thaat field filled for 19/92 ragas via a legitimate cross-reference join against the existing Hindustani/Carnatic equivalents table (not new research). aroha/avaroha/pakad/mood_character/therapeutic_goal remain null for all 92 ragas -- no musicological reference source is available to this pass. Each null field now carries an explicit '<field>_status: not_found' sibling so this is distinguishable from 'never checked'. Closing this fully requires either web access to a citable source or a domain expert supplying the data directly.

gaps.title: Reliable raga contraindication data
gaps.detail: New raaga/structured/raga_safety_metadata.json created. 7 ragas flagged condition_flagged (epilepsy/schizophrenia/Parkinson's/cardiac/blood-pressure associations already present in the traditional-indication data) routed to clinical_review_required. All other ~85 ragas explicitly marked evidence_level: insufficient with a usage_constraint that empty contraindications must never be read as 'confirmed safe'. This is the correct final state per the project brief's own instruction not to invent contraindications -- it is not expected to ever show anything other than 'insufficient' without real clinical input.

gaps.title: Throat/Third-Eye/Crown question review
gaps.detail: Formal QA review completed (see rag/assessment_technique/_QA_REVIEW_throat_third_eye_crown_2026_08.md). 1 leading question found and fixed (CQ-AJN-02). All 17 questions confirmed neutral, non-diagnostic, chakra-belief-free, and Crown/spiritual questions confirmed optional with explicit consent gating. review_status remains therapist_review_required on every question -- an AI QA pass is not a clinical validation.

gaps.title: Bilahari metadata / raga-research vs chakra-mapping distinction
gaps.detail: New raaga/structured/carnatic_raga_metadata.json created -- Bilahari represented as a Carnatic-tradition entity with its two (internally-inconsistent, flagged-not-resolved) Hindustani equivalents, rather than a fabricated single Hindustani mapping. chakra_raga_bridge.json re-reviewed and confirmed compliant with the raga-research/chakra-mapping separation requirement; annotated with an explicit confirmation note.

v5_0_update._note: Two therapist-provided documents integrated: (1) a fully-completed Chakra Indicator Strength Rating workbook, (2) a home-based MT activities guide.

additions.detail: 100% complete therapist ratings (171 symptom-chakra pairs, 20 emotions, 24 behaviours) merged into structured/symptom_to_chakra.json, emotion_to_chakra.json, behaviour_to_chakra.json as new 'indicator_strength_by_chakra' / 'indicator_strength' fields. Every entry-chakra pair matched by ID with zero discrepancies. This is the first real clinical weighting data available to the deterministic scoring engine -- previously every indicator counted equally regardless of how directly it points to a given chakra.

The same workbook's 'Disambiguation Qs Review' sheet (38 draft questions for symptoms/emotions/behaviours that map to multiple chakras) came back 0% filled -- registered as structured/pending_therapist_input/disambiguation_questions_pending_review.json with review_status: therapist_review_not_yet_started. Not fabricated or completed by this pass.

New file rag/clinical_frameworks/home_based_mt_activities_by_population.md -- practical, equipment-free activities across 8 populations/contexts (prenatal, school/college students, neurodivergent, corporate, seniors, general adults, emotional-challenge-specific). Fills a real gap: prior music_therapy_interventions structured data had technique names but blank practical-detail fields. Tagged CONTEXTUAL/RAG tier, not structured/decision tier -- no citations or evidence-level claims in the source.
